audit: Independent direct saved-NPZ to CSV verification; no fit or report functions invoked
checks: all dataset spot hashes and manually discounted payoffs
all saved net-error identities and cash-flow component identities
unique configuration evaluations and role aliases
all direct NPZ-derived summary CSV metrics
three-dataset sample SD and paired differences
per-run CSV fit and final metrics
unique cache groups and memory records
limitations: Cash-flow positions/trade arrays are not stored; detailed execution and gradient identities are covered by passing component tests.
Memory uses cumulative process peak and feature-array bytes, not isolated model allocations.
Three fixed reservoir draws are shared across datasets; dataset SD is conditional descriptive variation, not a confidence interval.
